text: {"label": "Reinforcement schedules from laboratory to practice","definition": "Work spanning basic and applied study of reinforcement schedules, including concurrent-schedule performance, changeover delays, and melioration, alongside multiple, lag, and response-independent schedules used clinically, often by parents, to reduce challenging behavior.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Broader and more translational than neighbours on variable-interval response rates, fixed-interval timing and schedule-induced behavior, or concurrent-chains choice theory, bridging laboratory schedule findings with applied interventions."}
